ruleDefinitions.name: Execute Code with Pester.bat as Parent
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects code execution via Pester.bat (Pester - Powershell Modulte for testing)

sequences.query: (((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\powershell\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\pwsh\\\.exe$")) AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\Modules\\\\Pester\\\\.*")) AND (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{\\ Invoke\\-Pester\\ \\-EnableExit\\ \\;.*") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\{\\ Get\\-Help\\ \\.*")))
